name: Data Patterns (India) Ltd
title: Data Patterns (India) Ltd - 543428 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue INR925cr (+31%) and EBITDA INR371cr (40% margin) on record INR1,121cr inflows, but Q4 revenue fell 13% YoY and no capacity or utilisation data was given; order conversion hinges on government timing.

capex.quote: we are building something about nine floor of factory space to build in additional capacity

triggers.label: FY26 order inflow +216% to INR1,121cr
triggers.quote: the company recorded order inflows of approximately INR1,121 crores, increase of 216% year-on-year
triggers.highlight: order inflows of approximately INR1,121 crores

triggers.label: Growth guided 20-25%, margin 38-40%
triggers.quote: We continue to target revenue growth of around 20%, 25% over the short term while maintaining healthy EBITDA margins of 38% to 40%

triggers.label: Q4 revenue down 13% YoY
triggers.quote: Q4 '26 revenue stood at INR345 crores, while the revenue was lower by minus 13% year-on-year

triggers.label: Cash conversion cycle 428 to 365 days
triggers.quote: Our cash conversion cycle improved meaningfully to 365 days in FY26 from 428 days in FY25

guidance.quote: We continue to target revenue growth of around 20%, 25% over the short term
while maintaining healthy EBITDA margins of 38% to 40%
We expect it to probably settle down at 320 to 340 days going forward

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue -13% YoY; 'timing of execution' cited
red_flags.quote: the revenue was lower by minus 13% year-on-year due to timing of execution of certain programs

red_flags.label: Lumpy government-dependent orders; INR1,900cr repeat orders untimed
red_flags.quote: The timing is not exactly visible.

red_flags.label: Order book 38% services with long AMC cycles
red_flags.quote: Service orders represent our AMC revenue. AMC is actually for multiple years.

red_flags.label: Inconsistent answers on order timing and delays
red_flags.quote: I never said anything like that. I never said anything like that.

evasions.topic: Order book at year end / FY27 order size
evasions.quote: I think it's a bit early for that. We will come towards the year -end before we give you the numbers.
I never talked about delays on any other thing.
I wouldn't like to comment on specific competition on open line.
You'll have to wait for Tejas order to happen, and we'll announce it to the market as and when the order happens.
